description: Searches any regional eBay marketplace for `keyword` and returns the listings as JSON: `title`, `price` + `currency`, `condition` (with a normalised `conditionCode`), `seller` (username, feedback percentage and score), `shippingCost`, `sold`, `watchers`, `bids`, `image` and a clean item `url`. Filter with `condition`, `listing_type`, `min_price`/`max_price`, `free_shipping`, `seller` or `category`, sort with `sort`, and page with `page`/`page_size` (60, 120 or 240 per page). Set `marketplace` to search a specific site - prices, currency and availability differ between ebay.com, ebay.de, ebay.co.uk and the rest. When eBay finds no exact match it still serves a full page of its own loosely-related suggestions. That case is reported honestly: `exactMatches` is `false` and a `notice` explains it, so those listings are never mistaken for real matches. Returns JSON. Billed like an API request; listing plugins bill one unit per result page they fetch, so keep max_results modest.

category.description: eBay category id to search inside, e.g. '131090' for vehicle parts and accessories.

condition.description: Item condition filter: new, open_box, refurbished, used, for_parts. Omit for every condition.

free_shipping.description: Only listings eBay marks as free delivery. Default: false.

keyword.description: Search phrase, e.g. 'iphone 13' or a part number like '1K0953519A'.

listing_type.description: Listing format: all, buy_it_now, auction. Default 'all'. Default: all.

marketplace.description: Regional eBay site to search. Prices, currency and availability differ per marketplace. One of: ebay.com, ebay.co.uk, ebay.de, ebay.fr, ebay.it, ebay.es, ebay.nl, ebay.pl, ebay.at, ebay.ch, ebay.be, ebay.ie, ebay.ca, ebay.com.au, ebay.in, ebay.ph, ebay.com.sg, ebay.com.my, ebay.com.hk. Default: ebay.com.

max_price.description: Highest price to include, in the marketplace's currency.

min_price.description: Lowest price to include, in the marketplace's currency.

page_size.description: Listings per page - eBay's own page sizes: 60, 120, 240. Default: 60.

proxy_country.description: Proxy country the request is sent from (ISO-2, e.g. 'US', 'DE'). Defaults to a country chosen for the marketplace.

seller.description: Restrict the search to one seller's username.

sort.description: Ordering: best_match, newly_listed, ending_soon, price_asc, price_desc. Default 'best_match'. Default: best_match.

name: ebay_search
title: Scrape eBay search listings
